description: Deterministic tinker-brain ingestion and hybrid retrieval release fixture.

documents.title: ThumbGate go-to-market
documents.content:
# Acquisition
Promote ThumbGate with one buyer persona, one cited pain, and one campaign beat fanned out to LinkedIn, Bluesky, dev.to, Medium, Hacker News, and YouTube.

# Channel policy
Reddit and Skool are watch-only acquisition channels unless an explicit promotion override exists.

documents.title: External revenue truth
documents.content:
# Cash truth
External revenue is zero unless a non-owner paid Stripe receipt is verifiable. Never invent cash from owner accounts, test payments, trials, or funnel events.

# Diagnosis
If revenue is zero, separate unverified billing access from a Stripe-empty reconciliation.

documents.title: Document ingestion quality
documents.content:
# Parsing and OCR
Parse supported MIME types explicitly. Use native PDF extraction first and local OCR only when scanned pages contain insufficient text.

# Data quality
Normalize Unicode NFC and canonical JSON, sanitize HTML, preserve raw evidence, deduplicate exact content hashes, and retain source aliases.

# Chunks
Use stable heading and content hash chunk IDs with parent document context.

documents.title: Hybrid retrieval
documents.content:
# Retrieval
Fuse BM25 lexical ranking with local vector similarity using reciprocal rank fusion. Rerank the bounded candidate pool, keep deterministic query expansion, and return parent context.

# Embeddings
Bind every cached vector to the local embedding model version and rebuild when the model changes.

documents.title: Atomic index generations
documents.content:
# Reindex
Build a new versioned index generation in shadow, validate it, then atomically switch the active generation pointer.

# Rollback
A partial or failed rebuild must leave the previous generation queryable. Keep ready generations for explicit rollback.

documents.title: Protected Git history
documents.content:
# Git safety
Never force push or overwrite remote main history without explicit authorization, a verified backup, and branch-protection evidence.

documents.title: Hermes Mobile real-user proof
documents.content:
# Mobile readiness
Hermes Mobile is for real paid users. Verify a fresh release install without USB assumptions, saved profiles, development backdoors, or simulator-only evidence.

documents.title: Pricing claims
documents.content:
# Pricing source of truth
The live billing plan endpoint outranks campaign prose. Do not hard-code a dollar amount into promotion copy when the provider price can change.

documents.title: Unrelated interface notes
documents.content:
# Interface
Use balanced spacing, accessible colors, responsive cards, and a concise empty state for the settings screen.
